questions.category: A. Use Safe Work Practices / B. Use Tools and Equipment
questions.question: A worker is preparing to cut galvanized sheet metal with a portable grinder. Which control is most important before starting?
options: Wear cotton gloves for better grip
Remove the guard for better visibility
Confirm the wheel rating, guard position, and spark direction
Hold the work by hand to reduce vibration
questions.explanation: Grinder wheels must be rated for the tool speed, guards must be in place, and sparks must be directed away from workers, combustibles, and finished surfaces.

questions.question: A worker finds an unlabeled container of solvent in the shop. What should be done?
options: Smell it to identify the product
Use it only for cleaning non-painted surfaces
Dispose of it or identify it according to workplace procedures
Mix it with water to reduce the hazard
questions.explanation: Unlabeled chemicals must not be used. WHMIS requires proper identification, labeling, and access to safety information.

questions.question: A set of drawings shows duct size as 600 mm x 300 mm. The note says, 'dimensions are inside clear dimensions.' What must the fabricator add during layout?
options: Nothing; fabricate exactly 600 mm x 300 mm outside size
questions.explanation: Clear inside dimensions refer to airflow opening. Fabrication layout must include locks, seams, joints, connectors, and edge allowances.

questions.question: A rectangular duct measures 30 in. x 18 in. What is the perimeter before seam allowances?
A sheet metal worker is laying out a square-to-round transition. Which method is most suitable?
questions.explanation: Square-to-round and rectangular-to-round transitions are irregular fittings commonly developed using triangulation.
